thread:
Morgan: Quick heads-up — need to move the router header-split cutover into a narrow quiet window tonight, 02:00–02:20 UTC. API + Runtime + Console need to coordinate pins/rollbacks.
Anita: Ack. Are we still doing staged canary or a single wave?
Morgan: Staged canary. 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 10min steps. If latency regression > 250ms p95 or error rate > 0.5% rollback immediately.
Samir: Runtime note — we have a kernel batching toggle that must be off for the header-split variant. I can prepare a pinned variant without batching.
Jia: Console needs a schema flag flip at the same time. I can gate it under feature.flag:header_split and coordinate with the rollout.
Clara: Router team: we'll push the header-shim config at 02:05 UTC. Can we get an explicit pin id from API/runtime/console to reference in the deploy plan?
Samir: Building a pinned image tag: r-runtime:v2026.02-headershim-pinned -> will upload by 01:30 UTC.
Anita: API will publish api:v2026.02-headershim-pin (hash: a3f9c1). ETA 01:40 UTC.
Jia: Console pin: web-console@2026.02-headershim (sha: bb7e4). ETA 01:45 UTC.
Morgan: Great. I'll draft the deploy bot wave. Deploy sequence:
```
# deploy-bot waves
wave 1: router-config -> 10% (02:05)
wave 2: runtime pinned -> 10% (02:07)
wave 3: api pinned -> 10% (02:09)
wave 4: console feature flag -> 10% (02:11)
repeat to 50% then 100% unless alerts fire
```
Samir: Can we include a KV cache warmup step for runtime to avoid cold token spikes?
Clara: Router will hold 5% extra traffic for 2 minutes to smooth out.
deploy-bot: Received wave plan. To proceed, confirm two signals: (1) all pinned artifact hashes posted, (2) rollback contact assigned.
Anita: Posted hashes above. Rollback owners: Samir (runtime), Jia (console), Morgan (router), Anita (api).
ops-bot: Alerting hooks set: latency-monitor, error-rate, p99-throttle. Paging on breach > configured thresholds.
Jia: Quick question — if console schema flip causes a minor validation error, do we prefer console-side fallback or full traffic rollback?
Morgan: Prefer console-side graceful fallback for non-breaking validation errors. Full rollback only if >0.2% user-facing errors or cross-service schema mismatch.
Samir: Noted. I'll add a KV eviction guard and short-circuit that reverts if we hit memory pressure.
Clara: One more — release notes: can someone draft a short blurb for the console change? Ops wants it in the post-deploy summary.
Anita: I'll write release note bullets and attach to the wave doc after the deploy.
Morgan: Timeline recap: pins uploaded by 01:45 UTC, deploy-bot dry run at 01:50, final go/no-go at 01:58, window open 02:00. If anything outstanding ping me and @ops on call. :thumbsup:
Samir: Uploads done by 01:36 (runtime hash r-hash-01).
Anita: API hash posted 01:42 (a3f9c1).
Jia: Console hash posted 01:47 (bb7e4).
deploy-bot: Dry run scheduled. Running preflight checks: artifact availability OK, feature gate toggle present, rollback hooks configured.
Clara: Starting router config push at 02:05 UTC. Will post status updates in this thread.
Morgan: Thanks all — stay ready on pager. Will call abort if any critical alerts come in.
Clara: Router push completed to 10% at 02:07. No immediate anomalies.
Samir: Runtime pinned rollout to 10% at 02:09. Memory + latency stable.
Anita: API 10% at 02:11. Error rate 0.03% p50 latency +15ms, p95 +40ms — within thresholds.
Jia: Console feature flag enabled on 10% at 02:13. Saw a small spike in client-side validation logs (<0.02%). Holding.
Clara: Increasing router to 50% at 02:15.
Samir: Rolling runtime to 50% at 02:17. Latency stable.
Anita: API 50% at 02:19. All green.
Jia: Console 50% at 02:21. Validation logs steady. Proceeding to 100%.
Clara: Router 100% at 02:23.
Samir: Runtime 100% at 02:25.
Anita: API 100% at 02:27.
Jia: Console 100% at 02:29. Monitoring for 30m.
ops-bot: Post-deploy summary will be generated and linked in 10m.
Morgan: Solid. No rollback needed. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
